0022600234.text: The Nets (2-8, 1-5 on the road) sit 13th in the East and 7 games back in the Atlantic, while the Grizzlies (7-3, 5-0 on the road) are on a one-game winning streak and 1.5 games back in the Southwest. Brooklyn will be without Mikel Brown Jr., who is out with illness and averaging 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes per game this season, and Nolan Traore, who is out with calf soreness, while Memphis is missing Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 series was split 1-1, with the Nets winning the most recent meeting 126-115 in Brooklyn on March 9, 2026.
